user.title: Zaptec Charging
user.description: Select the entities of your Zaptec charger and smart meter. Charging settings can be changed afterwards via Configure.

data_description.charger_mode_entity: Zaptec sensor with states like disconnected and connected_charging.
data_description.charge_power_entity: Current charge power of the charger in W.
data_description.available_current_entity: Zaptec installation number entity for the available current.
data_description.phase_switch_entity: Zaptec installation number entity (0 = always 3-phase, 32 = always 1-phase).
data_description.grid_export_entity: Current power returned to the grid in W, for example from a P1 meter.
data_description.grid_import_entity: Current power taken from the grid in W, for example from a P1 meter.
data_description.notify_service: Mobile app notify service for the charging choice. Leave empty to disable notifications.

data.stop_minutes: Stop after too little sun for
data.offer_stop_option: Offer 'Solar, otherwise stop' in the notification

data_description.charger_mode_entity: Zaptec sensor with states like disconnected and connected_charging.
data_description.charge_power_entity: Current charge power of the charger in W.
data_description.available_current_entity: Zaptec installation number entity for the available current.
data_description.phase_switch_entity: Zaptec installation number entity (0 = always 3-phase, 32 = always 1-phase).
data_description.grid_export_entity: Current power returned to the grid in W, for example from a P1 meter.
data_description.grid_import_entity: Current power taken from the grid in W, for example from a P1 meter.
data_description.notify_service: Mobile app notify service for the charging choice. Leave empty to disable notifications.
data_description.voltage: Used to convert surplus power into charge current.
data_description.min_current: Solar charging never goes below this current.
data_description.max_current: Used for forced charging and as upper limit for solar charging.
data_description.stop_minutes: Only when 'stop without sun' is selected.
data_description.night_forced_time: Switches to forced 3-phase charging, unless paused or 'stop without sun' is selected.
data_description.night_tariff_time: Start of forced charging when 'wait for night tariff' is chosen.
data_description.phase_value_1p: Value of the phase switch entity for 1-phase charging.
data_description.phase_value_3p: Value of the phase switch entity for 3-phase charging.
data_description.phase_wait_seconds: Time the charger needs after switching phases.
data_description.control_interval_seconds: How often the charge current is recalculated.
data_description.offer_stop_option: Adds a fourth choice to the notification.

error.max_below_min: The maximum current must be at least the minimum current.
error.phase_values_equal: The phase values for 1-phase and 3-phase must differ.
